transformations.rationale: The inherent `pub const unsafe fn` slice method is represented as a standalone `pub unsafe fn assume_init_drop<T>(slice: &mut [MaybeUninit<T>])` harness target; the public target remains executable and non-external.
The generated MaybeUninit relation helpers are inlined as specs so Verus can prove well-formed length facts without carrying the original assume_specification declaration.

The unsafe raw-pointer cast and `ptr::drop_in_place` expression from Rust 1.96 is isolated in one target-local external-body boundary because Verus does not model MaybeUninit raw storage, Destruct, and destructor effects directly.
